pre_registration_note: These gates were written into the repository before the holdout backtest numbers were produced, and the backtest applies them unchanged. Changing a gate after seeing a result is the exact failure mode this file exists to prevent; any change must be a new version with a note saying what moved and why.

tier_policy.Qualified: all gates pass -> eligible for reward points
tier_policy.Bronze (no reward): 5-9 gates pass -> listed on the leaderboard, zero points, no claim of edge
tier_policy.Rejected: <5 gates pass -> listed as rejected, zero points

reward_policy.points_awarded_rule: 1000 points to a strategy only if every gate passes; otherwise 0. No partial credit, no discretionary bonuses.
reward_policy.reason: Non-monetary. A cash prize on an unvalidated model turns research into promotion.

gates.name: Sample floor
gates.rule: n >= 300 graded bets in the holdout
gates.why: Below ~300 bets, a 52% hit rate is statistically indistinguishable from 50% at conventional confidence.

gates.name: Beats a naive baseline
gates.rule: own-line MAE < naive baseline MAE for both spread and total
gates.why: A model that cannot beat 'assume a 0-point margin / league-average total' has no information in it.

gates.name: Calibration
gates.rule: empirical 90% interval coverage between 0.85 and 0.95, and |mean residual| < 0.5 points
gates.why: Probabilities are only usable if the stated uncertainty matches reality.

gates.name: Market-informed bar
gates.why: The closing line is the strongest public forecast. A line originator that is less accurate than it is not adding information.
gates.warning: Passing G4 is necessary, not sufficient: the market is also where the price is set.

gates.name: Positive ROI with a lower confidence bound above zero
gates.rule: holdout ROI > 0 and the week-clustered bootstrap 2.5th percentile > 0
gates.why: A positive point estimate is not evidence; the lower bound has to clear zero.

gates.name: Not luck (placebo test)
gates.why: Bet the same number of bets, in the same weeks, on random sides; if random does as well, the result was variance.

gates.name: Stability across seasons
gates.rule: positive ROI in at least 60% of holdout seasons that had bets
gates.why: One hot season is a story, not a strategy.

gates.name: Prospective replication
gates.rule: the same rule, frozen, earns a positive ROI on games played after the freeze date
gates.why: This is the only test that removes the researcher's degrees of freedom entirely.

gates.name: Prop and parlay priceability
gates.rule: every leg is priced from an archived or official quote, and joint dependence is measured, not assumed
gates.why: Multiplying independent leg probabilities in the same game overstates the parlay price; without measured dependence and archived prices there is no bet to grade.

gates.name: Source and honesty gate
gates.rule: every published row carries a source link; every unverifiable value is blank and flagged
gates.why: An accurate number with no provenance is unusable, and a filled-in guess is worse than a blank.
